entities.summary: Géza Daruváry de Daruvár was a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister of Justice from 1922 to 1923 and Minister of Foreign Affairs between 1922 and 1924. Before the First World War he worked as a consul in several states. István Bethlen appointed him Minister of Justice in 1922. As foreign minister, he wanted to make a connection with the Soviet Union, but Daruváry didn't reach any results.

entities.summary: Géza Daruváry de Daruvár was a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister of Justice from 1922 to 1923 and Minister of Foreign Affairs between 1922 and 1924. Before the First World War he worked as a consul in several states. István Bethlen appointed him Minister of Justice in 1922. As foreign minister, he wanted to make a connection with the Soviet Union, but Daruváry didn't reach any results.
